cacheHint.zh-CN:
📁 完整输出已保存：{path}
如需调整搜索条件，直接 grep/read 该文件即可，无需重跑命令。
cacheHint.en-US:
📁 Full output saved to: {path}
To adjust the filter, grep/read the file directly; no need to re-run the command.

squashFromDescription.zh-CN: 要压缩的起始 user turn 索引，来自 session_log。
squashFromDescription.en-US: Starting user-turn index to squash, from session_log.

squashSummaryDescription.zh-CN: 压缩后的任务状态快照。重点说明已做工作、最终结果与验证，并明确当前停点、剩余事项和下一步；不要记录压缩过程。
squashSummaryDescription.en-US: Task-state snapshot after squashing. Focus on work completed, final outcomes, and verification, then state the exact stopping point, remaining work, and next action. Do not record the squash process.

validateInputNotFound.zh-CN: 找不到 user message 索引 {from}。

validateInputIncomplete.zh-CN: user message {from} 尚未完成，不能压缩未完成的 turn。
validateInputIncomplete.en-US: User message {from} is not complete yet; cannot squash an unfinished turn.

logDescription.zh-CN: 列出对话里尚未作为压缩起点的用户消息（原编号、内容、是否已回复），给 session_squash 挑起点用。已压缩消息仍可通过 /tree 找回。
logDescription.en-US: List user messages not already used as squash starting points (original index, content, replied or not) so session_squash can pick a start. Squashed messages remain available through /tree.

logSnippet.zh-CN: 列出未压缩消息和可选起点
logSnippet.en-US: List unsquashed messages and starting points

squashDescription.zh-CN: 把从指定消息开始的对话压缩成任务状态快照，释放上下文空间。原对话不删，/tree 可找回。适用时机：任务或阶段到达安全停点、对话太长、准备进入下一阶段或新任务。先用 session_log 看编号，再生成摘要并随本次调用提交。
squashDescription.en-US: Squash the conversation from a chosen message into a task-state snapshot to free context. Nothing is deleted; use /tree to go back. Good times include a safe task or phase checkpoint, a long conversation, or before the next phase or task. Run session_log first, then generate and submit the summary in this call.

guidelineBoundary.zh-CN: session_squash 通常在任务或阶段的安全边界调用：阶段完成、验证完成、关键决策落定或准备进入下一阶段时，即使整个任务尚未交付也可以压缩。上下文较高时尽快到达最近安全停点后压缩，不要等整个任务结束；收到【强制压缩】消息则立即调用 session_squash。
guidelineBoundary.en-US: Call session_squash at a safe task or phase boundary: after a phase or verification completes, a key decision is settled, or before the next phase. The whole task need not be delivered. When context is high, reach the nearest safe checkpoint and squash instead of waiting for task completion; call session_squash immediately on a [Forced squash] message.

guidelineIndex.zh-CN: 调用 session_squash 前先用 session_log 看消息编号，选择要压缩的已完成任务或阶段的第一条消息作为 from；进行中阶段也必须从已完成的 user turn 开始。
guidelineIndex.en-US: Before session_squash, call session_log and use the first message of the completed task or phase as from; an in-progress phase must still start from a completed user turn.

guidelineSummary.zh-CN: 调用 session_squash 时直接把完整任务状态快照放进 summary；重点先写 Work Completed（做了什么、作用对象、最终结果和验证，且禁止重复），再写 Current State（In Progress 的准确停点、Remaining、Blocked / Unknown）、仍有效的决策与制品，以及 Resume 的第一步动作和完成条件；不再有后续 finalize 步骤。
guidelineSummary.en-US: Pass the complete task-state snapshot directly in session_squash.summary. Lead with Work Completed (what changed, its target, final outcome, and verification; do not repeat it), then Current State (the exact In Progress stopping point, Remaining, and Blocked / Unknown), still-valid decisions and artifacts, and the first Resume action with completion criteria. There is no later finalize step.

guidelineSummaryIntegrity.zh-CN: session_squash 的摘要是有效状态而非聊天流水账：Completed 不得再出现在 Remaining 或 Resume；必要时标记 VERIFIED、INFERRED、UNKNOWN、NOT VERIFIED 或 BLOCKED。吸收旧摘要中的有效任务事实，但不要写入压缩、上下文阈值、session_log、session_squash 或会话切换等维护过程。
guidelineSummaryIntegrity.en-US: The session_squash summary is effective state, not a chat chronology: Completed work must not reappear under Remaining or Resume. Use VERIFIED, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, NOT VERIFIED, or BLOCKED when needed. Absorb valid task facts from earlier summaries, but omit maintenance mechanics such as squashing, context thresholds, session_log, session_squash, or session switching.

guidelineLeaf.zh-CN: session_squash 的压缩范围是 from 到对话末尾；from 之后聊的内容都会一起压进去。
guidelineLeaf.en-US: session_squash covers everything from the selected from turn to the latest message, including all later content.

guidelineContinue.zh-CN: session_squash 完成后会自动继续干活；接续时不得重复 Work Completed，必须从准确停点或 Resume 开始。想停下来就直接打断。
guidelineContinue.en-US: The agent keeps working automatically after session_squash; it must not repeat Work Completed and must resume from the exact stopping point or Resume action. Interrupt it if you want to pause.

continuationInstruction.zh-CN: 【任务状态快照】以下内容是当前有效任务状态。先确认 Work Completed，禁止重复其中的工作；从 Current State 的准确停点或 Resume 继续。若状态快照与实际 workspace、Git 或测试证据冲突，以实际证据为准并明确报告。
continuationInstruction.en-US: [Task state snapshot] The content below is the current effective task state. Read Work Completed first and do not repeat it; continue from the exact Current State stopping point or Resume action. If the snapshot conflicts with workspace, Git, or test evidence, follow the evidence and report the conflict.

pending.zh-CN: 已经有一个压缩请求在排队，等这轮说完就执行，别重复调用。
pending.en-US: A squash is already queued and will run when this turn ends; do not call again.

registered.zh-CN: 摘要已接收，将从第 {from} 条消息开始压缩。等这轮说完就执行，原对话不删。
registered.en-US: Summary received. Squashing from message {from} when this turn ends; the original conversation is kept.

squashSummaryEmpty.zh-CN: 摘要不能为空，请生成完整摘要后随 session_squash 一起提交。
squashSummaryEmpty.en-US: The summary cannot be empty; generate it and submit it with session_squash.

switched.zh-CN: 会话换了，排队中的压缩请求已取消。
switched.en-US: The session changed, so the queued squash was cancelled.

noInput.zh-CN: 找不到要压缩的起始消息，本次未执行。
noInput.en-US: Could not find the starting message; nothing was squashed.

noLeaf.zh-CN: 当前会话没有可压缩的内容。
noLeaf.en-US: There is nothing to squash in this session.

contextHint.zh-CN: 【上下文提示】当前已用 {tokens} / {contextWindow}（{contextPercentage}，本次提醒阈值 {threshold}）。如果任务或阶段已到安全停点，现在就先 session_log 再 session_squash；即使整个任务尚未结束也可以压缩，不要因此忽略本提示。若正处于不可中断步骤，先到最近安全停点再压缩。summary 要重点说明做了什么、最终结果与验证，并明确准确停点和剩余工作；不要记录压缩过程。
contextHint.en-US: [Context notice] Usage is {tokens} / {contextWindow} ({contextPercentage}; this reminder threshold is {threshold}). If the task or phase is at a safe checkpoint, run session_log then session_squash now. The whole task need not be finished, so do not ignore this notice for that reason. If an indivisible step is active, reach the nearest safe checkpoint and then squash. The summary must focus on work completed, final outcomes, and verification, then state the exact stopping point and remaining work; omit the squash process.

contextHintNotice.zh-CN: 上下文已用 {tokens} / {contextWindow}（{contextPercentage}，提醒阈值 {threshold}），已提醒主 agent 在最近的任务或阶段安全停点压缩。
contextHintNotice.en-US: Context usage is {tokens} / {contextWindow} ({contextPercentage}; reminder threshold {threshold}); the agent was reminded to squash at the nearest safe task or phase checkpoint.

forceInterruptNotice.zh-CN: 上下文已达 {tokens}（强制阈值 {threshold}），当前工具批结束后已中止任务并进入强制压缩模式。
forceInterruptNotice.en-US: Context reached {tokens} (forced threshold {threshold}); the task was interrupted after the current tool batch and forced squash mode is now active.

forceTaskPrompt.zh-CN:
【强制压缩｜第 {attempt} 次】上下文已达 {tokens}，超过强制阈值 {threshold}。立即停止原任务；在压缩成功前不得继续实现、解释或调用其他工具。

你现在只能：
1. 调用 session_log，选择一个已完成且足以释放上下文的起点；
2. 基于当前完整上下文生成任务状态快照；
3. 调用 session_squash，把 from 和完整 summary 一次提交。

summary 必须使用以下结构：## Goal & Constraints；## Work Completed（重点说明做了什么、作用对象、最终结果和验证，且禁止重复）；## Current State（含 In Progress 的准确停点、Remaining、Blocked / Unknown）；## Decisions & Evidence；## Artifacts（文件、分支、提交和日志状态）；## Resume（第一步动作和完成条件）。Completed 不得再次放入 Remaining 或 Resume；必要时标记 VERIFIED、INFERRED、UNKNOWN、NOT VERIFIED 或 BLOCKED。只记录继续任务所需的有效状态，吸收旧摘要中的任务事实，但不得记录压缩、上下文阈值、session_log、session_squash 或会话切换过程。即使任务尚未完成也必须现在压缩。不要只回复文字，必须完成 session_squash 调用。

forceToolBlocked.zh-CN: 强制压缩期间禁止调用 {tool}；只能调用 session_log 和 session_squash。
forceToolBlocked.en-US: Tool {tool} is blocked during forced squash; only session_log and session_squash are allowed.

forceSwitched.zh-CN: 会话已切换，原会话的强制压缩模式已取消并恢复工具。
forceSwitched.en-US: The session changed; forced squash for the previous session was cancelled and tools were restored.

forceConfigInvalid.zh-CN: 配置 {path} 中的强制压缩比例无效；必须是 0 到 1 的 JSON 数字，强制压缩保持关闭。
forceConfigInvalid.en-US: The forced squash ratio in {path} is invalid; it must be a JSON number from 0 to 1, so forced squash remains disabled.

configInvalid.zh-CN: 配置 {path} 解析失败，已用默认阈值。
configInvalid.en-US: Failed to parse {path}; default thresholds are used.

configInvalidEnv.zh-CN: 环境变量 {env} 解析失败，已用默认阈值。
configInvalidEnv.en-US: Could not parse env var {env}; default thresholds are used.

configCommandDescription.zh-CN: 配置提醒阈值或强制压缩比例（force 0.9 / force off）
configCommandDescription.en-US: Configure reminder thresholds or forced squash ratio (force 0.9 / force off)

configNoUi.zh-CN: 当前环境无交互 UI，无法用命令配置，请直接编辑配置文件。
configNoUi.en-US: No interactive UI available; edit the config file directly instead.

configPrompt.zh-CN:
输入新的压缩阈值（逗号分隔，支持 150k、75% 或数字；留空取消）：
当前：{current}
configPrompt.en-US:
Enter new squash thresholds (comma-separated; supports 150k, 75%, or numbers; leave empty to cancel):
Current: {current}

configForceParseError.zh-CN: 强制压缩比例无效：{value}；请输入 0 到 1 的数字（示例：force 0.9、force off）。
configForceParseError.en-US: Invalid forced squash ratio: {value}; enter a number from 0 to 1 (examples: force 0.9, force off).

configForceSaved.zh-CN:
已启用强制压缩比例：{ratio}
配置：{path}

configForceDisabled.zh-CN:
已关闭强制压缩。
配置：{path}

done.zh-CN: 压缩完成，已生成总结（原对话可用 /tree 找回）。
done.en-US: Squash complete; a summary was generated (use /tree to go back).
